Reluctant Knife

Someone once paid you to make a problem disappear. You still decide what that made you.

Which name did you cross off without taking the job?

Rules

Choose one:

- Subterfuge 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6625e61df1cd42c0.JournalEntryPage.57676794a816d120]{A Courtesy Unanswered}. - Arms 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.086240b5cbcc8c57.JournalEntryPage.d0280691efc36fc7]{Take Them Alive}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +5 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
